name: Chinese Measure Words · 汉语量词
description: 汉语量词 195 个（含 1 张引导卡）：按 HSK 等级升序平铺，每词配英文用法说明、典型搭配（数词+量词+名词）与自撰例句。量词按七类着色（个体/集合/容器/度量/时间/动作/类别），等级徽章 HSK1-9（HSK+ = 词表外高频补充）。朗读中文量词（lang: zh），可隐藏搭配作自测。

sampleData.usage: the all-purpose measure word: people, everyday objects, and most nouns that have no special measure word (一个星期).
sampleData.example: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。
sampleData.exampleEn: I have an older brother and a younger sister.

sampleData.usage: a cup or glass of (一杯茶, 一杯水).
sampleData.exampleEn: I would like a cup of hot tea.

sampleData.usage: time, occasion — counts how many times something happens (第一次 = the first time).
sampleData.exampleEn: I have been to Beijing twice.

sampleData.usage: for flat, sheet-like objects: paper, tables, beds, photos and tickets.
sampleData.exampleEn: I want to buy a table.

sampleData.usage: for pairs of things that come in twos (a pair of shoes, socks, chopsticks).
sampleData.exampleEn: I bought a new pair of shoes.

sampleData.usage: jin, a Chinese weight unit equal to 500 grams (half a kilogram); 半斤 = half a jin.
sampleData.exampleEn: I bought two jin of apples.

sampleData.usage: for small round objects: stars, teeth, pieces of candy and pearls (一颗星星, 一颗糖).
sampleData.example: 天上有一颗最亮的星星。
sampleData.exampleEn: There is one brightest star in the sky.

sampleData.usage: a string or bunch of items threaded or clustered together (一串葡萄, 一串钥匙).
sampleData.exampleEn: He is holding a bunch of keys.
